title: ShinonLLM — Component Contract
description: User-facing personality layer. Sits between the user and Promtguard. Character-first: attitude tracking (-10..+10), two-tier memory (Hot→Mid→Cold), Contract Gates, Replay Gates. Asks 'How does it sound?'

component.name: ShinonLLM
component.description: Erste Schicht die der User sieht. Persönlichkeit, Ton, Attitude-State. Übergibt aufbereiteten Input an Promtguard.

input.title: Shinon Input Contract
input.description: Raw user input with conversation context. Shinon receives this and produces character-contextualized output.

session_id.description: Session identifier for memory and attitude persistence

memory_context.description: Additional memory context (backend preferences, model hints, etc.)

output.title: Shinon Output Contract
output.description: Character-contextualized output ready for Promtguard handoff.

reply.description: Always empty — Shinon only annotates (never generates text). LIMEN generates the reply from handoff_to_promtguard.

should_confront.description: Whether Shinon detected a contradiction requiring confrontation

tone_directive.description: Tone instruction for downstream prompt generation

handoff_to_promtguard.description: Structured handoff payload for Promtguard ingestion

processed_input.description: User input enriched with character context annotations

character_annotations.description: Metadata Promtguard uses for prompt refinement

model.description: LLM backend used for this turn

state.title: Shinon Persisted State
state.description: What Shinon persists between turns. Two-Tier Memory + Attitude + Contract/Replay Gates.

cold_memory.description: Shinon COLD memory reads from KARMA Facts (shared truth source). No separate cold table.

contract_gates.title: Contract Gates
contract_gates.description: Deterministic validation that runs before Shinon accepts or produces output.

rules.description: Fail-closed: malformed input rejected with error code
Fail-closed: output schema violation prevents handoff
Only permitted character actions pass through

replay_gates.title: Replay Gates
replay_gates.description: Like KARMA's Replay Engine, but on conversation history. Enables re-evaluating past character decisions with updated attitude rules.

known_gaps: Pattern Engine expects PersonalFact objects — userText conversion not implemented
Two-Tier Memory requires SQLite adapter — currently stub returning empty results
Attitude persistence via SQLite — stub returns neutral state
Handoff to Promtguard: interface defined but no runtime integration
